clips.title: The story
paras: Protect Kanati Greycloud is a Horde quest at Whitereach Post in Thousand Needles. Warned that centaur assassins have targeted the tauren Kanati Greycloud, adventurers must make a stand beside him and repel a squad of Galak assassins.

While stationed among the towering sandstone spires of Whitereach Post, the tauren Kanati Greycloud learns from intercepted centaur orders of an assassination plot directed squarely at his life. The Galak tribe of centaur, relentless in their hostility toward the nomadic tauren and their Horde allies, are not content merely raiding supply paths; they seek to eliminate those who settle in their canyons.

Realizing the attack is imminent and suspecting the enemy forces might outnumber his initial estimates, Kanati asks travelers at the post to fight alongside him. When the Galak assassins strike, Kanati stands his ground, relying on allied blades and spells to break the ambush before the centaur can claim their prize.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: But, there may be more centaur than I thought, I ask you, friend, to fight with me against these vile assassins.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for your help, friend. I couldn't have held them off without you.
